description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden, adding {C}{C}.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
